entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm a bit lost. I ordered something and it's... it's not right. I think I need to send it back?
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide your order number? And just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the item?
Oh, um, let me find it. Okay, it's VF-8675309. It's the new cycling jersey I bought. I tried it on and it's just the wrong size.
Okay, thank you for that order number. So with the jersey, is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?
A preference? I guess so. It's just much too tight across the shoulders. The website sizing chart was a little confusing. I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course. I understand completely, and I'm happy to walk you through it. Let me just pull up your order... I see you received the jersey 8 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return window, so this will be no problem at all.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief. I was so worried. So what do I do now? I'd like to get the right size.

We can definitely process an exchange for a different size. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now, which I'll send to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the package with the jersey inside, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the next size up for you.
Okay, that sounds... simple enough. You're sure it won't be a problem that it's just because it's too tight?
Not a problem at all. Getting the right fit is important. The exchange process is designed for exactly this reason. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
